items.title: 66086_Zilner T. Randolph oral history interview
items.q: the boys called me -- nicknamethey called me Jazz Baby.

ctx.x: Well, by this time had you started arranging, or started studying composition in any way?
No, I hadn't started studying arranging or composition, I was just playing the horn. But I was jazzing, because the boys called me -- nicknamethey called me Jazz Baby.
